proposals.rationale: Entire LGB pool lives in one deep regime (leaves 242-363, mcs 11). A depth-3/7-leaf strongly regularized model is bias-dominated: residuals decorrelate from the champion family. Mirrors the shallow-XGB member that took largest weight in s6e1.
proposals.expected: Solo ~0.890-0.893; value only via reblend weight.

proposals.rationale: Only one XGB regime exists (depth 8, lr 0.03). Depth-3 high-lr heavy-L2 XGB with aggressive column subsampling is the shallow bias-dominated archetype; different splitter adds ranking diversity.
proposals.expected: Weak solo (~0.891-0.893); success = nonzero reblend weight.

proposals.rationale: Random-subspace view: pool LGBs use feature_fraction 0.75-0.8 on full features. Halving columns (0.4) + rows 0.55 + 3-flag drop forces different interactions; unconstrained depth with mcs 40 is absent from the pool.
Pool CatBoost is only deep (9-10) with temperature <=1. Shallow depth-4, heavy L2, temperature-5 Bayesian bootstrap = stochastic bias-dominated CatBoost with distinct ordered-statistics handling.
